summary: The base reproducibly raises at the reported unconditional torch.stack when crop counts differ. The exact candidate adds a heterogeneous-shape path that encodes each item independently and concatenates embeddings in request order, while retaining the homogeneous batched path. Candidate tests and an independent three-item CPU/gfx950 oracle passed. This verifies the source-level contract for valid heterogeneous gundam inputs; the full baidu/Unlimited-OCR HTTP server was not run because weights were unavailable.

tests.what_was_measured: Independent three-item heterogeneous crop fixture failed at unlimited_ocr.py torch.stack with [1,12,3,2,2] versus [1,1,3,2,2], using the prepared source import. Evidence: raw/base_adversarial.txt.
All four candidate regressions passed, covering heterogeneous order and flags, homogeneous fast-path batching, absent flags, and GPU execution. Evidence: raw/candidate_tests.txt.

Independent oracle verified three crop counts (12,1,3), output values/order, spatial metadata, per-item flags, and one encoder invocation per item on CPU and gfx950. Evidence: raw/candidate_adversarial.txt.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e50450f70c4e/venv/bin/python script calling dynamic_preprocess on reported dimensions
tests.what_was_measured: The prepared revision produced 24 and 12 crops for (2925,4454) and (2242,3157), confirming heterogeneous real preprocessing despite counts differing from the older issue snapshot. Evidence: raw/preprocess.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent candidate execution created tensors, dispatched the corrected control flow, concatenated results, and checked exact values on GPU 0: AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. This was a model-method fixture, not a full server/model run.

remaining_limitations: The baidu/Unlimited-OCR weights were unavailable, so the original full HTTP serving scenario, scheduler survival, and semantic model output were not executed.

The issue reported CUDA on an RTX 3090; the available accelerator was one ROCm AMD MI355X/gfx950. The failing torch.stack and corrected tensor/control-flow contract are architecture-independent and were exercised on CPU and gfx950.

General scheduler-level isolation from unrelated multimodal encoder exceptions is not added by this candidate; that broader blast-radius concern is outside the valid heterogeneous-tile counterexample fixed here.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
